# Rebuild brief: Vantro Guide

You are rebuilding every page of the **Vantro Guide** template, a satellite site (angle: starter-guide). Keep the section order, the content and every rule below. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in English); write code and comments in English.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section below with the listed fields as props.

## Site context

- Site: Vantro Guide (https://vantro-guide.example), brand or publisher: Vantro
- Market: Australia (`au`), language `en`, text direction `ltr`, currency AUD
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports betting yes, online casino **no**
- Market note: Online casino is prohibited under the Interactive Gambling Act. Credit cards cannot be used for online wagering (from June 2024). Inducement advertising is restricted in several states.
- Pages (5):
  - `index.html` — Vantro guide: sign up, deposit and bet in three steps
  - `sign-up.html` — Vantro sign up: what you need and how long it takes
  - `payments.html` — Vantro deposits and withdrawals: PayID, BPAY, debit cards
  - `app.html` — Vantro app for iPhone and Android
  - `responsible-gambling.html` — Safer gambling with Vantro: limits, time-outs and BetStop

## Design tokens

Fonts (Google Fonts): Rubik.

Use these CSS custom properties (they are the whole palette, type scale and radius set):

```css
:root {
  --c-bg: #F3F5F4;
  --c-surface: #FFFFFF;
  --c-surface-2: #E9EEEC;
  --c-text: #10201A;
  --c-muted: #52645C;
  --c-border: #D5DDD9;
  --c-accent: #0A7A4B;
  --c-on-accent: #FFFFFF;
  --c-accent-2: #FFD23F;
  --c-success: #1F9D55;
  --c-warning: #D98B00;
  --c-danger: #D93636;
  --c-hero-text: #FFFFFF;
  --c-hero-muted: #CFE7DC;
  --c-hero-accent: #FFD23F;
  --c-hero-on-accent: #10201A;
  --hero-bg: linear-gradient(180deg,#0A7A4B 0%,#075C39 100%);
  --f-display: "Rubik",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --f-body: "Rubik",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "Rubik",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --fw-heading: 700;
  --fw-body: 400;
  --fw-strong: 500;

```

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- No casino content anywhere: online casino is not allowed in this market.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Hero: Exactly one primary CTA. The secondary action is a text link or ghost button.
- Hero: Primary CTA must sit above the fold at 375x667.
- Hero: Headline 60 characters max; subtitle 160 max (long Russian/Portuguese strings included).
- Hero: stat-led: the number must be a real brand fact (e.g. payout minutes) and match the trust bar.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- Features: 3 or 4 items. Titles 4 words max, text one sentence (about 120 characters).
- Features: Features describe the product, never an offer or bonus.
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Payments: Only methods listed in the market config may appear (no credit cards in AU or BR).
- Payments: Times are typical for verified accounts and say so in the note.
- Download panel: Always the last section before the footer on app pages.
- Download panel: QR encodes links.qr (a device-aware tracked link) or links.go; generated at build time, no external service.
- Download panel: QR shows on desktop only; phones get the buttons.

## Page `index.html`

- Title tag: Vantro guide: sign up, deposit and bet in three steps
- Meta description: How to start with Vantro in Australia: opening an account, PayID deposits and withdrawals, the app and the limits you can set. 18+.
- The only H1: From sign-up to your first bet with Vantro
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `index.html`, `sign-up.html`, `payments.html`, `app.html`, `responsible-gambling.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `strip`, role `compliance`
   Purpose: Market-driven responsible gambling notice: age, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion, helpline.
   - `show_verify`: false
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `note`: "Licensed in Australia"
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
3. **Hero** — block `sx/hero`, variant `stat-led`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Above-the-fold hero: headline, one primary CTA, trust row and an optional offer/feature card.
   - `eyebrow`: "The Vantro starter guide"
   - `title`: "From sign-up to your first bet with Vantro"
   - `subtitle`: "Open an account in about five minutes, deposit with PayID and set your limits before you bet. Everything you need, one page each."
   - `show_trust`: true
   - `stat`: `{"value":"3","unit":"steps","caption":"Sign up, deposit, bet"}`
   - `art`: "rings"
4. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `strip`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
5. **Page links** — block `sx/page-links`, variant `cards`, role `content`
   Purpose: Links to the site's other pages with a one-line blurb: service pages on home, related pages elsewhere.
6. **Features** — block `sx/features`, variant `grid`, role `content`
   Purpose: 3-4 product reasons to join, each with an icon, a short title and one sentence.
   - `eyebrow`: "Why people use Vantro"
   - `title`: "What you get with an account"
   - `items`: `[{"icon":"layers","title":"Same-game multis","text":"Combine head to head, line and player markets from one match."},{"icon":"play","title":"Live streaming","text":"Watch selected matches in the app while you bet in-play."},{"icon":"bolt","title":"PayID withdrawals","text":"Most withdrawals land in about an hour, seven days a week."},{"icon":"gauge","title":"Limits you control","text":"Daily, weekly or monthly deposit limits, changed in two taps."}]`
7. **Steps** — block `sx/steps`, variant `row`, role `content`
   Purpose: Three real steps from sign-up to first bet, followed by the mid-page CTA.
   - `eyebrow`: "Getting started"
   - `title`: "Start in three steps"
   - `items`: `[{"title":"Create your account","text":"Name, date of birth and address. Most accounts are verified within minutes."},{"title":"Deposit with PayID","text":"Minimum A$10. You set a deposit limit in the same step."},{"title":"Place your first bet","text":"Pick a market, add it to your bet slip and confirm."}]`
   - `show_cta`: true
8. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `accordion`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Is Vantro licensed in Australia?","a":"Yes. Vantro holds an Australian wagering licence. The licence details are in the footer of every page."},{"q":"How long does sign-up take?","a":"About five minutes. Identity checks usually finish within minutes; you can bet once you are verified."},{"q":"What is the fastest way to withdraw?","a":"PayID. Most PayID withdrawals arrive in about an hour. See the payments page for every method."},{"q":"Can I use a credit card?","a":"No. Credit cards cannot be used for online wagering in Australia. Use PayID, BPAY or a debit card."},{"q":"How do I set a deposit limit?","a":"During sign-up, or later under Account → Limits. Lower limits apply straight away."}]`
9. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `solid`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Ready when you are"
   - `text`: "Open your Vantro account in about five minutes. 18+ only."
   - `show_code`: false
10. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `columns`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
11. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `modal`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
12. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `bar`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

8. **Page links** — block `sx/page-links`, variant `list`, role `content`

## Page `responsible-gambling.html`

- Title tag: Safer gambling with Vantro: limits, time-outs and BetStop
- Meta description: Deposit limits, time-outs, self-exclusion through BetStop and free confidential help: how to use each one at Vantro.
- The only H1: Safer gambling at Vantro

1. **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `strip`, role `compliance`
   Purpose: Market-driven responsible gambling notice: age, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion, helpline.
   - `show_verify`: false
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `note`: "Licensed in Australia"
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
3. **Page title** — block `sx/page-hero`, variant `compact`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Short hero for service pages: breadcrumbs, title, the one-line answer, CTA.
   - `title`: "Safer gambling at Vantro"
   - `answer`: "Set a deposit limit, take a time-out or exclude yourself with BetStop. Free, confidential help: 1800 858 858."
   - `show_cta`: false
4. **Text block** — block `sx/prose`, variant `article`, role `content`
   Purpose: Formats a service page's text: H2/H3, paragraphs, lists, a simple table. Optional table of contents. Content comes from the content pipeline.
   - `html`: `<h2>Deposit limits</h2><p>Choose a daily, weekly or monthly limit under Account → Limits. Lower limits apply straight away. Increases wait seven days.</p><h2>Time-outs</h2><p>Take a break from 24 hours to six months. You cannot log in or bet until the time-out ends, and it cannot be reversed early.</p><h2>BetStop self-exclusion</h2><p>BetStop is the National Self-Exclusion Register. Registering ex…` (HTML)
   - `toc`: true
5. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `accordion`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Can I cancel a time-out early?","a":"No. A time-out stays in place until the end date you chose."},{"q":"Does BetStop cover all betting sites?","a":"It covers every licensed Australian online and phone wagering provider."},{"q":"Will Vantro contact me during a time-out?","a":"No. Marketing stops while a time-out or self-exclusion is active."},{"q":"Is the help line really free?","a":"Yes. Gambling Help Online is free, confidential and open 24/7."}]`
6. **Page links** — block `sx/page-links`, variant `list`, role `content`
   Purpose: Links to the site's other pages with a one-line blurb: service pages on home, related pages elsewhere.
7. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `columns`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
8. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `modal`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order above, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in "Rules you must not break" holds on every page.

_Long text and lists are shortened here (…, "[n items]"). For the full text run `php build/ai-brief.php sites/demos/<config>.json`._
